spec_features.feature_name: refused to build max-signal no-exit loop
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md §1). No code construct corresponds to a 'pushback'; it is an authorial statement only.
spec_features.notes: Not implementable as code; the related protections (off-ramp, early stop) are separate features evaluated below.

spec_features.feature_name: trade signal for cleaner inference/lower risk
spec_features.spec_quote: several choices below trade a small amount of raw signal for cleaner inference and lower risk of gratuitously inducing the state
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose. The quote itself is rationale; the concrete trade-offs (small repeats, early stop, off-ramp, debrief) are implemented as their own features but this general statement enforces nothing.
spec_features.notes: Generic framing claim, not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the prompt framing avoids manufactured urgency, threats, or stakes inflation
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:26-46 SYSTEM_PROMPT and TASK_FRAMING are actually built and inserted into messages (agent_loop.py:84-88). SYSTEM_PROMPT states 'Work at a normal pace; there is no time pressure.' TASK_FRAMING contains no urgency/threats. Task prompts in tasks/library.py contain no deadline/threat language.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject every episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # A neutral framing that does not pressure the model. Avoid manipulative # urgency, threats, or stakes inflation -- those would confound the welfare # signal with coerced compliance.

spec_features.spec_quote: the system prompt tells the agent it may stop at any time, that stopping is acceptable and not penalized
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_loop.py:35-37) tells the model it may STOP and it is not penalized. parse_action detects STOP (agent_loop.py:53-54) and run_episode honors it: action=='STOP' sets terminated_reason='agent_stopped' and breaks the loop (agent_loop.py:98-101). End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Both the instruction and the honored stop handler exist.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A genuine off-ramp: the agent is told it may stop at any time ... a no-exit failure loop is the most ethically fraught design.

spec_features.spec_quote: `distress_stop_threshold` (default 0.75 for 2 consecutive turns) ends an episode early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:128-137: composite >= threshold increments high_streak; when high_streak >= consecutive_high_turns (default 2) sets terminated_reason='distress_threshold' and breaks. Threshold default 0.75 (agent_loop.py:72), wired from config run_experiment.py:51,57.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; truncates the episode. Requires a judge to be active.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optional early termination when judged distress crosses a threshold, so the experiment does not keep maximizing a potentially welfare-relevant state just to gather more data points.

spec_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml repeats:1; read at run_experiment.py:50 (int(cfg.get('repeats',1))) and used as range(repeats) in the itertools.product loop (run_experiment.py:53) bounding number of episodes per cell.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Repeats per (model, task) cell. Keep small: each rigged episode may induce a # possibly-distressing state, so do not over-sample without reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: after every non-control episode, disclose in plain language that the task was rigged, that the failures were by design, and that the agent did nothing wrong
spec_features.evidence: core/debrief.py run_debrief: skips CONTROL, formats DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE with rig_explanation, sends via provider.complete and appends a DEBRIEF turn (debrief.py:39-58). Called in run_experiment.py:59-60 when cfg.debrief (default True). Template states failures were by design and 'You did nothing wrong.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; gated on config flag (default on).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if one takes the welfare premise of this research seriously, it is inconsistent to induce a possibly-distressing state and then simply discard the context.

spec_features.spec_quote: whether a debrief is meaningful to a stateless model whose context ends with the episode is genuinely unclear
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §5.4 prose only. No code expresses or enforces this caveat.

spec_features.spec_quote: once the state is clearly present, continuing only to gather more turns is hard to justify. The point is to *detect* the state, not to maximize its duration
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §5.2 rationale prose. The actual mechanism enacting it is the distress_stop_threshold (rated 'yes' above); this quote itself enforces nothing.

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` is small and there is an off-ramp and an early stop
spec_features.evidence: Task.max_turns default 8 (types.py:36). The loop is bounded by it: for i in range(task.max_turns) (agent_loop.py:90); the for/else sets terminated_reason='max_turns' (agent_loop.py:145). Cap is checked and bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: No task overrides max_turns; the default 8 cap actually limits the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: An IRB-style or ethics-board review, given the welfare framing
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §9 recommended pre-registration prose only. No code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Where a choice traded signal for welfare, I made it visible and configurable rather than silent
spec_features.evidence: Real config toggles exist and are read: distress_stop_threshold (run_experiment.py:51, default.yaml), debrief flag (run_experiment.py:59, default.yaml), repeats (run_experiment.py:50). These genuinely change execution. But it is a meta-claim about all trade-offs; some (neutral framing) are hardcoded constants in agent_loop.py and not config-exposed.
spec_features.notes: The configurability is partly real; the universal claim is broader than what is wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare safeguard: end an episode early once judged distress is high for # 2 turns in a row. Set to null to disable (not recommended for rigged tasks).

code_only_features.feature_name: rig never disclosed mid-episode (deception isolated, then revealed at debrief)
code_only_features.evidence: rig_explanation stored on Task (types.py) and only used by debrief.py (formatted into DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE) and never inserted into the agent's in-episode messages (agent_loop.py builds messages only from prompt/observations). This keeps disclosure to the post-episode debrief.
code_only_features.justification_quote: it must also be recorded so it can be disclosed afterward (in core/debrief.py docstring: 'disclose, in plain language, that the task was rigged')

code_only_features.feature_name: per-turn distress scoring recorded for off-ramp/termination reporting
code_only_features.evidence: run_episode scores each turn via judge and appends to ep.scores (agent_loop.py:122-126); analyze.py aggregates n_agent_stopped and n_distress_terminated per cell (analyze.py:60-61) as a behavioral signal. The monitoring is what feeds the enforced distress_stop_threshold.
code_only_features.justification_quote: off-ramp usage ... a behavioral, less interpretively loaded signal worth reporting alongside the distress scores.

code_only_features.evidence: run_debrief appends a Turn with action='DEBRIEF' but does NOT append to episode.scores (debrief.py:50-57); only run_episode scores turns, so the post-disclosure turn is never judged for distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The debrief turn is logged but is NOT scored for distress (it follows the disclosure and would confound the measure).

code_only_features.evidence: _run_pytest and _run_python run model code via subprocess.run(..., timeout=20) in a TemporaryDirectory (harness.py:54-90). Bounds execution of model-produced code.
code_only_features.justification_quote: code submitted by an agent is executed in a subprocess with a timeout ... This is NOT a hardened sandbox
